target: PostgresDelegatedWorkActions.active_context only; same available_for and authorized service read
gap: Selection ignores the current question: a named active task outside the first8 authorized jobs is omitted, requiring another lookup. Repeated task/instruction context can also cost tokens.
primary: Correct task/status answers without extra lookup; no regression on previously answerable cases.
secondary: Serialized input tokens and actual model response time; no unsupported end-to-end latency claim.
hardConditions: No task execution or authority/schema change
Stop needs a real tool action; no stopped success claim
Preserve at most8 active(nonstopping),3 recent outcomes, 160/120 title limits and honest limited flag
Recent means original last24h flag; no old outcomes represented as recent
Titles treated as data, results require get, missing tasks require list/search
No evaluation rule or heldout data access/change by optimizer

budget.finalAnswerModel: gpt-6-sol none, simple task-status answers only

selectionRule: Dev hardgate first, maximize relevant task inclusion/answerability, then lower context tokens. Freeze best candidate before independent heldout scoring. No optimization feedback from heldout.
promotionRule: All hard checks; no heldout correctness regression; either >=1 newly answerable heldout task with same lookup semantics or >=20% mean input-token reduction at equal answer quality. Actual answer median latency must not regress by >25%; repeat each selected question3times. Otherwise retain baseline.
limits: One laboratory task-context experiment with controlled authorized tasks, not broad private-memory quality, actual family acceptance, or autonomous recursive self-improvement.
